senses.gloss: f. (שָׁפַת) placing over or by the fire.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:8">Kel. VIII, 8</cite> <he>מכנגד שְׁפִיתַת הקדרה ולפנים</he> from the place where the pot is placed and inside (towards the fire).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:9">Ib. 9</cite> <he>כור שיש בו בית ש׳</he> a smelting pot which has a bottom or foot whereon it can rest (Mish. ed. <he>בור וכ׳</he> a hole in the ground with an arrangement for putting a pot over fire); a. e.
